headline: FIRE CREW now roars: wind bed + ladder creak land with a nine-world Magic Carpet and the first COMET CUP
lede: Slot a shipped the shelf's loudest gap fix tonight: seat 3 finally hears the gales. Behind it, slot b landed Magic Carpet's nine worlds and slot a's earlier session debuted tournament racing for the drift pack — plus the nightly freeze cleared on a green fix run.

notes.text: FIRE CREW: pure sim voices windVoice/ladderCreak — calm silent, breeze a soft low bed, gale loud and deep, plus a load moan when the extended ladder catches a gust. Rng-free; firecrewcheck 112/112 (+8), firecrewplay +4 browser gates, 3 mutants red-on-target. The first src-pin attempt missed (it matched a test hook, not the scheduler) — pins now target the assignment.
MAGIC CARPET: nine worlds (quotas to 265, three cycling atmospheres) + a title world-select, 60/60 seeds win all nine; economy policy pinned after a nine-world soft-lock family was found by sweep.
COMET DRIFT GP: the COMET CUP — three legs, live 10-8-6-4-3-2-1 classification, standings tiebreaks, gold badge arming. New cometcupplay drives all three legs on real keys with checkpoint gates.
#601 freeze cleared: the archery releasing-gate fix went green on nightly, and merges resumed. Phantom-gap hygiene in two READMEs keeps weakestStage honest about which game is actually weakest.
